subject: EXTERNAL clause
notes: §13.18.22.4 GR1: "If the EXTERNAL clause is specified in a record description entry, the data contained in the record is external and may be accessed within the run unit by any runtime element that describes the same record as external" + NOTE 1 "Use of the EXTERNAL clause does not imply that the associated file-name or data-name is a global name." (cite.py OK §13.18.22.4 1)). A WS EXTERNAL record is re-based onto ONE run-unit ExternalTable cell keyed by its externalized name. Probe GR1 (two separately-described source elements, CALL): sub reads caller's `HELLO`, caller then reads sub's `WORLD`; a same-named NON-external LOCALX stays per-program (`LOCAL` in the caller after the sub moved XXXXX to its own). NOTE 1 half: probe NOTE1 - a CONTAINED program referencing the container's EXTERNAL XS without describing it gets COBOL1639 'not defined', i.e. EXTERNAL does not confer global visibility. Both halves verified. The golden l1_cancel_external_unchanged derives cross-element sharing from §13.18.22 (default-name WS record in two elements). || Editions (adjudicator): 1985, 2002, 2014, 2023
